protocol.optimizer: AdamW, lr5e-4, warmup100, cosine to1%, wd1e-4, clip12
protocol.sampling: uniform horizon, then patient, then target within patient/horizon
protocol.selection: fixed terminal quantity; eligible spatial candidates every1000
protocol.initialization: copy scalar 17-32-32 backbone and frozen eight-scenario projection; count log median starts at log(max(1,1000*scalar mean)), logistic scale from scalar log variance floor0.1 cap2; trainable AR residual heads
protocol.training_losses: joint Bernoulli and conditional native-count NLL; no location gradient into quantity
protocol.presence_initialization: horizon-balanced fitting patient prevalence; no selection targets
protocol.domain: native cutoff image support union current predicted anatomy; no future expansion

observation_context.support_contract: observed brain union native predicted anatomy; zero change preserves native map
observation_context.target_contract: all native five-category reference voxels, including cavity outside image support

retained_image_completion_tradeoff: Frozen observation model: previously measured approximately 2.9% higher LUMIERE missing-FLAIR lesion MAE; no retraining or substituted checkpoint

artifacts.quantity_checkpoint_role: fixed terminal diagnostic candidate; not selected or accepted
artifacts.local_timeline_scope: portable FLAIR, maps and metadata; full saved states retained on GPU, current/completion sources unchanged
